tools.name: start_mock_interview
tools.description: Starts a practice mock interview for a job: returns 5 realistic interview questions for the given job title (and company, if given), shown as a question card.

tools.name: get_answer_feedback
tools.description: Gives feedback on one practice interview answer: a verdict (Strong, Good start or Needs work), what worked, the one thing to fix, and a stronger way to start the answer, shown as a feedback card.
